div.div: جِرْيَةٌ i. q. جَرْىٌ as inf. n. of جَرَى said of water (Msb, K) and the like: (K:) and also A mode, or manner, of running [thereof]. (TA.) You say, مَا أَشَدَّ جِرْيَةَ هٰذَا المَآءِ [How vehement is the running, or manner of running, of this water!]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
